item.title: Open Source Face Recognition SDK
item.description:

This SDK positions itself as a fully on-premise alternative: detection, landmarking, and feature extraction all run locally with no network calls.

item.title: obsidian pm

item.title: TablePro
item.description:

MacOS database clients force a trade-off: single-engine open source tools (Sequel Ace, Postico) or polished multi-database tools that are either proprietary (TablePlus) or non-native (DBeaver, Beekeeper Studio).
